description:
AKASHAR  brings together curious minds, passionate innovators, and problem-solvers driven by an interest in science, technology, and exploration.  We aim to transform ideas into meaningful solutions through creativity and collaboration. We welcome enthusiastic members with skills in programming, AI/ML, data science, reasearch, and design, above all valuing curiosity, teamwork, and a willingness to learn.

AKASHAR — Beyond the Known, into the Possible.
